predictions.selection_reason: Removed entity decoding before protocol validation -> allows bypass of javascript: protocol filter via encoded entities
predictions.source_summary: URLs come from markdown parsing (reference links, autolinks, images) and are normalized via normalizeLink() which uses mdurl.parse/encode but does not decode entities
predictions.sink_summary: validateLink return value controls whether links are rendered as active hyperlinks vs. plain text
predictions.guard_summary: BAD_PROTOCOLS array blocks javascript:, vbscript:, file: protocols. Validation occurs after trim() and toLowerCase() but before entity decoding
predictions.risk_pattern: Protocol validation bypass via encoded entities - javascript: protocol can be obfuscated as javascript: or javascript: to bypass filter
used_variable_sources: url parameter from markdown parsing contexts
predictions.context_summary: validateLink is called after normalizeLink() processing to block dangerous protocols before link rendering
unresolved_facts: Whether normalizeLinkText's entity decoding was previously used before validateLink
Exact change history showing removed entity decoding step

retrieval_query.mechanism_summary: Improper input validation for URL protocol due to order of operations: entity decoding should occur before protocol check, but it occurs after (or is removed). This allows encoded entities like javascript: to bypass the filter.
